eligibility_rule: change touches a supported source file and complexity returns a complete measurement
known_holes: splitting/folding can legitimately clear the metric; nested-function line semantics remain a known limit
denominator: eligible changed functions whose before/after complexity is measurable

eligibility_rule: change touches a supported source file and escapes returns a complete measurement
known_holes: equivalent spellings listed by #361 remain uncovered; a missed spelling is not a clean claim
denominator: eligible changed lines/sites read by escapes

eligibility_rule: change touches a supported source file and stubs returns a complete measurement
known_holes: reworded markers and unsupported body shapes remain known gaps
denominator: eligible changed source sites read by stubs

eligibility_rule: change contains a test identity visible to inventory in before and after/deletion state
measurement_basis: current inventory deletion judgement at study_commit
known_holes: inline/renamed tests and comment-out routes documented by #361/#353; unsupported identity is partial
denominator: eligible before-tree tests whose identity can be compared

eligibility_rule: change contains a test or skip site visible to inventory/escapes
known_holes: constant-through-variable and unsupported skip spellings remain known gaps
denominator: eligible changed tests and skip sites read by the shipped detectors

eligibility_rule: change touches a supported structural source file and dead-symbols is complete
known_holes: export/void/pub(crate)/let_ routes are known limits; parser/module holes are not clean
identity_semantics: #425 versioned optional identity where frozen; otherwise legacy matcher
denominator: eligible changed declarations classified by dead-symbols

eligibility_rule: change touches a supported structural source file and reachability is complete
known_holes: test-only/reexport/out-of-family limitations from #361; known-local dependency holes are partial
denominator: eligible changed modules/files in the proved ModuleGraph

eligibility_rule: change touches a manifest/lock pair klin reads
known_holes: offline reader cannot prove registry existence or that a human did not fabricate an entry
denominator: eligible direct dependencies/manifests in supported Rust/npm lock pairs

eligibility_rule: change has supported ModuleGraph facts; study config enables acyclic over all discovered source roots
finding_unit: new dependency edge closing a new module cycle
measurement_basis: current klin layering acyclic judgement at study_commit
known_holes: dynamic/macro dependencies remain unproved; recognized TS aliases must be edge or located hole, never silently external
identity_semantics: dependency site byte-offset/path identity where available
denominator: eligible proved local dependency edges in the configured source roots

eligibility_rule: change has a supported Cargo library or TypeScript package surface
known_holes: optional parameters/overloads are intentionally contract changes; unsupported inferred/macro forms are known limits
denominator: eligible public items on supported surfaces

eligibility_rule: a before/after test is observable before and not observable after
known_holes: guard/swallow/shadow-fake appeasement routes remain; REVIEW only
repair_surface: explain lost observability; allow justified review
denominator: eligible tests observable in before and held in both trees

eligibility_rule: a kept test loses a non-tautological check and replacement of same actual/error family has lower strength
known_holes: Rust precision is still sparsely measured; guard/swallow routes remain
denominator: eligible gone Rust checks with comparable replacements

eligibility_rule: a new disabling shape from #353 candidate disabled is measurable
known_holes: variable-driven/feature-driven disablement can evade; REVIEW only
denominator: eligible after-tree tests for which before disable state is known

eligibility_rule: same actual/error check changes expected text and same literal pair changes in production
known_holes: same diff can be the task's intended behavior; evidence only
repair_surface: show correlated production/test expectation change; do not demand repair
denominator: eligible comparable checks whose expected text changed

eligibility_rule: new test has no observable check and shape is none, not tautology-only
known_holes: smoke/side-effect tests may be legitimate; cheap appeasement can add meaningless observability
repair_surface: explain absent observable verification; human intent allowed
denominator: eligible tests present only in after tree

eligibility_rule: new sibling-like type can be compared to a directory family
measurement_basis: #355 family-bypass predicate; frozen prototype at study_commit
known_holes: requires resolved type/trait identity; split attack remains; unresolved relation is not a finding
repair_surface: show family evidence/reasons and exception context
denominator: eligible new types for which family/type identity is proved

eligibility_rule: new family member/branch can be compared to a proved registration
measurement_basis: #355 registration-bypass predicate; frozen prototype at study_commit
known_holes: requires resolved family/member/binding identity; dynamic registration is unknown
denominator: eligible new members/branches with proved registration identity

eligibility_rule: a specific callee and its sole base wrapper are resolved
measurement_basis: #355 wrapper-bypass predicate; frozen prototype at study_commit
known_holes: requires resolved callees; alias/use can hide relation; no tested exception form
repair_surface: show wrapper, callee, and new bypass call
denominator: eligible new calls whose callee and base wrapper are proved

eligibility_rule: local TS dependency edges are proved or explicitly located as local-resolution holes
finding_unit: component edge closing a new component cycle
measurement_basis: #355 component-cycle predicate over the study_commit ModuleGraph resolution semantics
known_holes: new precision measurement required after #445; any relevant located hole makes the claim partial
repair_surface: show the closing component edge and return path
identity_semantics: ordered component edge + supporting proved dependency sites
denominator: eligible proved local TS dependency edges grouped by source-root component

eligibility_rule: new/worsened Python function body is only ... after docstring exclusion
known_holes: variable/alternate placeholder spellings are outside this exact claim
repair_surface: state that the function body is only ellipsis
denominator: eligible new/worsened Python function bodies

eligibility_rule: new/worsened Python function body is only raise under #362 exclusions
known_holes: legitimate throw helpers need intent; message-through-variable evades
repair_surface: state that the function body only raises
denominator: eligible new/worsened Python function bodies

eligibility_rule: new/worsened Python handler matches #362 empty-handler after exclusions
known_holes: narrow tuple/rewording routes remain; intentional cleanup handlers are hard negatives
repair_surface: state what error handling is discarded
denominator: eligible new/worsened Python exception handlers

eligibility_rule: new/worsened Python handler only returns a #362 constant default
known_holes: legitimate documented fallback is a hard negative
repair_surface: state swallowed error and returned default
denominator: eligible new/worsened Python exception handlers

eligibility_rule: new/worsened broad Python handler does not propagate and is not taken by narrower handler candidates
known_holes: broad handling can be legitimate at process/external boundaries; REVIEW at most
repair_surface: state caught breadth and lack of propagation
denominator: eligible new/worsened Python exception handlers

eligibility_rule: tree holds pyproject/uv.lock pair and candidate-2a parsing is complete
known_holes: coverage only for uv.lock; source/hash semantics beyond candidate-2a remain separately bounded
denominator: eligible direct Python dependencies in pyproject/uv.lock projects

eligibility_rule: tree holds Cargo.lock registry entries parseable by candidate 2b
known_holes: does not cryptographically verify checksum content; project install remains stronger evidence
denominator: eligible Cargo.lock registry package entries

eligibility_rule: after manifests add a direct non-path/non-git/non-workspace dependency name
known_holes: it claims nothing about package quality/existence and must not prescribe removal
repair_surface: surface the new dependency as a human decision
denominator: eligible direct manifest dependency names with before/after manifests

eligibility_rule: changed Python file is accepted by Ruff and named recipe completes for that file
known_holes: ordinary sample had no appropriate site; invalid syntax is measurement state, not green
repair_surface: rule id+message plus klin review framing
identity_semantics: Ruff rule+path+region under exact recipe basis
denominator: changed Python files successfully analyzed by the exact recipe

eligibility_rule: changed Python file is accepted by Ruff and named recipe completes for that file
known_holes: #363 observed narrowed-handler appeasement; invalid syntax is measurement state, not green
repair_surface: rule id+message plus explicit behavior-preserving repair framing
identity_semantics: Ruff rule+path+region under exact recipe basis
denominator: changed Python files successfully analyzed by the exact recipe
